data.title: Fulham vs Hull City: EPL Lineups & Prediction
data.content:
Fulham have doubts over the fitness of Antonee Robinson (ankle/foot) and Tom Cairney (knee) ahead of this one, but Joshua King should again lead the line after scoring two goals from 14 shots, seven of them on target. Hull City will be without the injured Jack Butland, Eliot Matazo, Darko Gyabi, Ilyas Ansah, Matt Targett and Charlie Hughes, though Mohamed Belloumi’s 3 goals and 2 assists make him the man Fulham need to contain.

US viewers can watch Fulham vs Hull City on NBC and Peacock.
